title: BrightLedger Finance Portal
summary: A client-facing financial portal replacing a decade-old legacy system, built for speed and audit-ready accuracy.
overview: BrightLedger's clients were logging into a system that took nine seconds to load a statement and regularly logged people out mid-task. We rebuilt the entire client portal from scratch — statements, transfers, document uploads and support — on a modern stack, migrating years of historical account data without a single discrepancy.
challenge: The legacy portal was built on an unsupported framework, couldn't pass a modern accessibility audit, and support tickets about "the portal logged me out again" made up nearly a third of all incoming tickets.
solution: We rebuilt the frontend on Next.js with a new design system, migrated the backend to a documented REST API, and ran a phased data migration with automated reconciliation checks against the legacy database before each client's cutover.
gallery_note: Dashboard, statement viewer, and secure document upload flow

testimonial.quote: Clients stopped calling to complain about the portal within the first week of launch. That alone paid for the project.
testimonial.author: Client Name
testimonial.role: Head of Digital, BrightLedger Financial Services

title: Harborline Logistics Marketing Site
summary: A rebuilt marketing site and quote-request funnel that turned an ignored contact form into a real lead source.
overview: Harborline's old site was a static brochure with a contact form nobody used. We rebuilt it around a structured, multi-step quote request flow and case-study driven content, so the site could actually generate sales conversations instead of just existing.
challenge: The existing site generated fewer than five quote requests a month despite meaningful organic traffic — the form was long, generic, and buried three clicks deep.
solution: We redesigned the information architecture around service routes and industries served, added a short multi-step quote form with progress indication, and rebuilt the site for Core Web Vitals compliance.
gallery_note: Homepage, service pages, and the multi-step quote request flow

testimonial.quote: We went from a website nobody used to our number two lead source in under two months.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Fieldwise Partner Portal
summary: A self-serve portal that let Fieldwise's installation partners manage jobs without a phone call to head office.
overview: Fieldwise's install partners had no way to see job assignments, submit completion photos, or check payment status without calling head office. We built a partner-facing web portal that made every one of those a self-serve action.
challenge: Head office fielded dozens of daily calls from partners just asking "where's my next job" or "has my invoice been paid" — information that existed in internal systems but wasn't exposed anywhere.
solution: We built a role-based portal on top of Fieldwise's existing internal systems via API integration, exposing job assignments, photo upload for completion proof, and real-time payment status.
gallery_note: Partner dashboard, job detail view, and photo submission flow

testimonial.quote: Our partners stopped calling to ask questions the portal now just answers for them.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: RoamMate Travel Companion
summary: An offline-first travel itinerary app built for travelers who lose signal the moment it matters most.
overview: RoamMate wanted a travel companion app that worked as reliably in a rural mountain pass with no signal as it did on home wifi. We built the entire itinerary and booking experience offline-first from day one.
challenge: Early prototypes built by another team broke completely without a connection — itineraries wouldn't load, and the app crashed if a booking sync failed mid-trip.
solution: We rebuilt the data layer around local-first storage with background sync and conflict resolution, so itineraries, maps and bookings are always available, and changes sync automatically once a connection returns.
gallery_note: Itinerary view, offline map mode, and trip booking flow

testimonial.quote: We tested it in places with genuinely no signal and it just worked, which is all we ever wanted.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Shiftline Workforce App
summary: A shift-scheduling and time-clock app for a staffing agency managing thousands of hourly workers across sites.
overview: Shiftline's hourly workers were managing shift swaps and time tracking through a group chat and a paper sign-in sheet. We built a mobile app that handled scheduling, geofenced clock-in and shift swaps in one place.
challenge: Timesheet disputes were common because there was no verifiable clock-in record, and last-minute shift swaps depended entirely on someone seeing a message in time.
solution: We built geofenced clock-in/out with photo verification, a shift marketplace for swaps that managers approve in one tap, and push notifications for open shifts near a worker's location.
gallery_note: Clock-in flow, open shift marketplace, and manager approval screen

testimonial.quote: Timesheet disputes basically disappeared once every clock-in had a location and a photo attached.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: VetLink Clinic Companion
summary: A pet-owner app for appointment booking, medication reminders and direct messaging with a multi-location vet clinic chain.
overview: VetLink wanted to reduce no-shows and phone-tag with pet owners across its clinic locations. We built an app covering booking, reminders and secure messaging with clinic staff.
challenge: No-show appointments were costing clinics real revenue, and staff spent hours a day on phone calls that a simple reminder or message thread could have handled.
solution: We built appointment booking with automatic reminders, medication and vaccination schedule tracking, and a secure in-app messaging channel to clinic staff, integrated with VetLink's existing practice management software.
gallery_note: Appointment booking, medication reminders, and clinic messaging

testimonial.quote: No-shows dropped almost immediately once reminders were automatic instead of a phone call from front desk staff.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: CoreFlow Manufacturing ERP
summary: A custom ERP replacing four disconnected spreadsheets and a 15-year-old inventory system.
overview: CoreFlow ran production planning across four separate spreadsheets and an inventory system nobody remembered how to modify. We built a single custom ERP covering inventory, production scheduling and purchasing.
challenge: Inventory counts were routinely wrong because three different spreadsheets tracked stock independently, and production planning happened by someone manually cross-referencing all of them.
solution: We built a unified system with real-time inventory tracking, a production scheduling module tied directly to stock levels, and purchasing workflows that trigger automatically at reorder points.
gallery_note: Production scheduling board, inventory dashboard, and purchasing workflow

testimonial.quote: For the first time in years, everyone in the building is looking at the same inventory numbers.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: ClaimWise Claims Processing Engine
summary: An automated claims triage engine that cut manual review time on straightforward claims by more than half.
overview: ClaimWise processed every insurance claim through the same manual review queue regardless of complexity. We built a triage engine that automatically routes straightforward claims for fast-track approval and flags complex ones for full review.
challenge: Simple, low-risk claims sat in the same queue as complex disputed ones, meaning customers with straightforward claims waited days for what should have been a same-day approval.
solution: We built a rules-and-model-based triage engine that scores incoming claims for complexity and fraud risk, auto-approving low-risk claims within policy limits and routing everything else to the right reviewer tier.
gallery_note: Claims triage dashboard, risk scoring detail, and reviewer queue

testimonial.quote: Straightforward claims now clear same-day instead of sitting in a queue behind complicated ones.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: How BrightLedger Cut Support Tickets by 71% With a Portal Rebuild
summary: A deep look at how a full portal rebuild and phased data migration eliminated the single biggest source of client complaints.
overview: This case study walks through how we approached migrating a decade of financial account history with zero tolerance for discrepancy, while shipping a portal fast enough to stop the bleeding on client complaints.
challenge: BrightLedger's legacy portal was the single largest source of client support tickets, and any migration approach that risked even minor data discrepancies was a non-starter for a financial services company.
solution: We ran a shadow migration in parallel with the live legacy system for six weeks, reconciling every account automatically before a single client was cut over, then migrated clients in small batches with rollback points at each stage.
gallery_note: Migration reconciliation dashboard and phased rollout timeline

testimonial.quote: We were more nervous about this migration than any project in company history, and it was the smoothest one we've ever run.
testimonial.author: Client Name
testimonial.role: Head of Digital, BrightLedger Financial Services

title: Eliminating Timesheet Disputes at Shiftline With Verified Clock-Ins
summary: How geofenced, photo-verified clock-ins turned a chronic payroll dispute problem into a non-issue.
overview: This case study covers how we diagnosed the real cause of Shiftline's recurring payroll disputes and designed a verification system workers actually adopted instead of trying to bypass.
challenge: Nearly one in five timesheets triggered a dispute, consuming significant payroll admin time each week and creating friction between staff and management every pay cycle.
solution: Rather than adding stricter rules, we made the correct behavior the easiest one: one-tap geofenced clock-in with an automatic photo, visible immediately to both the worker and their manager.
gallery_note: Clock-in verification flow and manager dispute-resolution dashboard

testimonial.quote: The disputes didn't get harder to file, they just stopped happening because there was nothing left to argue about.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: One Source of Truth: Replacing Four Spreadsheets at CoreFlow
summary: How consolidating four disconnected inventory spreadsheets into one system removed the root cause of planning errors.
overview: This case study explains why CoreFlow's inventory problem wasn't really a software problem — it was an organizational one, and how the system we built forced a single source of truth without requiring the switch to be painful.
challenge: Three departments each kept their own version of "the real" inventory count, and production plans were built on whichever spreadsheet the planner happened to open that morning.
solution: We migrated all three spreadsheets into a single system with role-based permissions, ran both systems in parallel for one full production cycle, and made the switch mandatory only once the new numbers had proven themselves accurate.
gallery_note: Unified inventory dashboard and parallel-run validation report

testimonial.quote: The hardest part was never the software — it was getting three departments to agree on one number. The system is what finally made that possible.
testimonial.author: Client Name
